final: WITH counts AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS examination_count FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), shares AS (SELECT ID, examination_count, 1.0 * examination_count / SUM(examination_count) OVER () AS share, 1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER () AS average_share FROM counts) SELECT ID, examination_count, share, share - average_share AS margin_above_average FROM shares WHERE share > average_share ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC, ID LIMIT 10
